name: What should I prepare before getting an estimate for a foreclosure rehab?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before getting an estimate for a foreclosure rehab?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before meeting an on-site contractor, prepare a clear property history, secure utility access, and identify your end goal—whether you are flipping, renting, or moving in. Gather any available home inspection reports, utility records, and notes on missing equipment like water heaters or panels. Verify that the bank or utility company has turned on water and power, or clarify if temporary power is needed for tools. Knowing your planned timeline and exit strategy also helps your contractor recommend the most cost-effective materials, whether rental-grade surfaces or higher-end custom trim and tile.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather inspection reports, confirm utility availability, and define whether you plan to rent, sell, or occupy the home to help your contractor determine the right finish scope.
